subject.title: chore(deps): bump the swift-deps group across 1 directory with 4 updates

question: Must the refreshed final head pass signed-app smoke for Sparkle updater availability and Peekaboo bridge startup, or are focused macOS and security checks sufficient for this dependency-only update?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-compatible, but the two most consequential dependencies operate at packaged updater and privileged automation boundaries that ordinary Swift checks do not directly exercise.

options.title: Require packaged smoke
options.body: Refresh the branch and verify Sparkle updater availability plus Peekaboo bridge startup in a correctly signed macOS app before merge.

options.title: Accept focused CI
options.body: Merge after refreshed exact-head macOS and security checks while explicitly accepting the unexercised packaged-runtime behavior.

options.title: Split runtime pins
options.body: Replace the grouped PR with separate Sparkle and Peekaboo updates for smaller validation and rollback units.

recommendation.title: Require packaged smoke
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and verify Sparkle updater availability plus Peekaboo bridge startup in a correctly signed macOS app before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent macOS runtime history and ownership of the updated Peekaboo dependency make him the best available owner for the packaged-runtime proof decision.
